mail.subject: Report: Sweep the clubhouse
body: The sweep held. No one reached the coolers.
Final: CSR 2, STA 9. The Rustlers lost.

mail.subject: Sweep: Rustlers clubhouse is clean
body: Our people walked the tunnels and checked the coolers. Two men with burlap sacks were turned away at the bullpen gate.
Jobs against the Rustlers today will be harder.

mail.subject: Welcome to the league
body: Here's $1,000 and a free starter pack. Spend it wisely, or don't.
Games air every half hour. Bets close at first pitch.
Remember: nothing in this league is fixed. Officially.
